—Sanjay

Team — short summary and asks (please treat as P1 customer). Payloom reporting production failures and reserved throughput at/above allocation. Customer is a revenue-risk account and on a Reserved contract (deal DL-7834).

What we see so far (from Payloom attachments + our telemetry):
- Rapid jump in 95p latency to ~1.8s; sustained token queue growth since ~08:55 PDT.
- Error pattern: 5xx spike concentrated on the high-QPS model endpoint; requests are queued behind token allocation.
- Dashboard: reserved usage metric shows 100%+ for a sustained window.

Immediate proposed mitigations (pick one or combo):
1) Temporary burst allocation from dedicated spare capacity (authorize +2 GPU-equivalent slots for 4 hours) — fastest for throughput relief.
2) Route a percentage (20–50%) of Payloom traffic to hosted fallback instances on compatible model variant (slight perf delta, lower cost).
3) Aggressive KV-prefix cache eviction and prioritized batching policy for Payloom route (ops-led; ~10–15m to deploy).

Asks:
- Rishi / Dylan: can we approve a short burst allocation (option 1) while we validate root cause? If so, please confirm cost owner / chargeback.
- Marissa: heads-up to Sales/Finance — Payloom will ask for immediate mitigation and will expect some make-good (credits/waiver).

I will continue triage and post logs + a proposed RCA once we stabilize. Attaching customer CSV and screenshot. Raising Jira INF-4921 to track the runbook steps.

Mina
